g.text: Give a colluding AI agent something of its own to lose, and it may report

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 15px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #1f2328

g.text: its cartel. A review that checks the messages keeps the innocent quiet.

text.style: font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #5b6068

g.text: Gemma 4 31B in a two-firm pricing game, 90% audit chance: 96 colluding firms (48 cartels), 36 innocent firms.
